name: Selected-rate native contraction and hardware comparison
schedule: Five randomized isolated blocks of ten arms. Each block shares its RFM seed across the four RFM arms. Repeat deterministic methods once per block. Pin CPU affinity and use a single BLAS thread.
requirements: Before timing, validate the completed selected-rate screen and all six new native CPU accuracy rows, plus independently verified compiler and binary metadata. Freeze the source, C and native binary hashes, actual qualification artifacts, exact two references and audit, and per-block order. Save all raw fields, observations, timings and failures. All timed runs must meet both references, sustained alternating wake and the matched implementation field/probe tolerance. Keep the original rate-screen guards and no retuning.
timing: Time a fresh in-process solve, including model setup, coefficients and plan construction, full marching, probes and checkpoint collection, CUDA synchronization, transfer and teardown when applicable. Exclude reference preparation, scoring and artifact serialization. Report five raw times, range, and within-block ratios. Keep any failed arm visible and withhold its matched-accuracy claim.
contrasts: CPU native versus recurrence at rate112 isolates the operator implementation. Same-seed CUDA rate128 versus rate112 with the same spatial discretization isolates the rate change. Compare selected Galerkin and FD on the same backend at the shared accuracy gate.
